'''Aiko''' is a maid in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]].

==Appearance==
She is plump with gray hair.

==History==
Aiko is one of the maids assigned to [[Moiraine Damodred]] when she comes to the Aesdaishar Palace.{{ref/book|0|24}}
